name: AniHype
description: AniHype (anihype.sbs) - anime with the site's rows (Trending, Airing now, Latest releases, Most popular, Highest rated, Top rated this year, Coming soon, Movies, Action, Fantasy, Romance, Comedy, Sci-Fi, All-time favourites), search and episode titles. Every link is checked before it is shown.
